what_this_is: the encoder's resident memory, measured before a deployment topology was chosen
why: project 7 shipped a multilingual model with a 250,000-token vocabulary onto a 512MB instance; the loaded session measured 671MB, the container was killed on every query, and the number was knowable in advance. This project measured first.

comparison.difference_is: vocabulary size: 250,000 multilingual tokens against roughly 30,000 English ones, and the embedding table dominates

consequence: this deployment runs the encoder live and answers free text, where project 7 had to serve precomputed query vectors only
